import bpy, os, base64, pathlib
src=r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews\upper_refinement_test.png'
out=r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews\upper_refinement_compact.jpg'
if not os.path.exists(src): raise RuntimeError('snapshot source missing')
img=bpy.data.images.load(src, check_existing=False)
img.scale(320,240)
scene=bpy.context.scene
old_format=scene.render.image_settings.file_format
old_quality=scene.render.image_settings.quality
try:
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG'
    scene.render.image_settings.quality=45
    img.filepath_raw=out
    img.file_format='JPEG'
    img.save()
finally:
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format=old_format
    scene.render.image_settings.quality=old_quality
try: bpy.data.images.remove(img)
except Exception: pass
data=base64.b64encode(open(out,'rb').read()).decode('ascii')
base=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews')
chunk=1000
parts=[data[i:i+chunk] for i in range(0,len(data),chunk)]
for i,p in enumerate(parts):
    (base/f'upper_refinement_compact_{i:02d}.txt').write_text(p,encoding='utf-8')
print(f'UPPER_COMPACT chunks={len(parts)} base64_chars={len(data)} file_bytes={os.path.getsize(out)}')
